The pattern composes Agentic Process Automation, Digital Workforce & Multi-Agent Orchestration, Autonomous Workflow Orchestration from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Cold-chain management, Supplier verification, Recall response) on Achala Swarm and Achala Nexus and Achala Compass.
